name: Ramp
text: Add a 4px solid focus ring in the brand color (not default gray) on every focusable element that isn’t already styled. This guarantees keyboard users see where they are without hurting contrast or touch targets. The trade-off is a tiny visual tweak that some designers will resist for “cleanliness,” but it’s the fastest way to fix the most common keyboard barrier.
